source.prompt: Tech house song, about 3.5 minutes, 127 BPM, G minor. Dark, hypnotic late-night warehouse mood with a warm groove. Cool, low, close-mic female lead vocal, half-whispered on the verses and full on the chorus, with tight doubled harmonies on the hook. Rolling syncopated analog bassline, short filtered organ stabs, dry rimshot and shaker percussion, soft delay-thrown vocal echoes, deep sub. Four-on-the-floor kick, shuffled off-beat open hats, soft claps on 2 and 4, rolling 16th-note percussion. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, mm

[Verse]
